purpose: Teach: 輸出入/顛末/参与/受け手/撤収/マージン/例示/売り出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究機材の輸出入手続を学習しろ
lines.en: Ren, you need to learn the export and import procedures for research equipment.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. No wasted words. Weight behind the name at the start. Calm authority—the kind that doesn't need to raise volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。前回の実験失敗の顛末を学会論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I actually covered the details of the last experiment's failure in a conference paper.
lines.style: Earnest and quick. Slight eagerness to show he's already been thinking ahead. Respectful but not obsequious—meeting expectations, not performing them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の参与会議に出席しろ
lines.en: Ren, I want you to attend the academic advisory meeting.
lines.style: Deliberate pause before the request. Clear and unhurried. This is an opportunity, not a chore—tone carries that weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術発信は受け手を意識しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping the audience in mind with how I communicate the research.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. Slight nod of understanding in the cadence. Professional register—this is Ren speaking to authority, but the sincerity comes through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、撤収が必要なテーマも見極めろ
lines.en: Ren, you also need to identify which areas might require us to pull back.
lines.style: Steady, no softening of the difficult message. Matter-of-fact. The kind of guidance that trusts Ren to understand what he's being asked.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費のマージン部分を予備に充てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll allocate the margin from the research budget as a reserve fund.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Practical and forward-thinking—showing he's already parsing the implication. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文には例示を多く入れろ
lines.en: Ren, put plenty of concrete examples in the paper.
lines.style: Simple, direct instruction. No elaboration needed. The tone of someone who knows exactly what will strengthen the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新論文の売り出し戦略を学会担当者と相談します
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with the conference organizers about the launch strategy for the new paper.
lines.style: Final affirmation with a soft close. Ren is demonstrating he's absorbed all the guidance. Professional composure, a thread of quiet determination underneath.
